text:
Ran into an old colleague today. Apparently the dead CAN come back to haunt you. 🙄

Welcome back, @Bonesy. #TheatrePeople

replies.text: BONESY, DARLING!!! 💋💕 So lovely to see you! We simply MUST have lunch!
Remember opening night in...
CHAMPAGNE! WHO WANTS CHAMPAGNE?! 🍾🥂
I thought you were dead.
Technically.
I'm calling my attorney.
Good to see some things haven't changed.

text:
A gentleman asked whether my frosting was stiff enough.

Darling, I've been dead for YEARS.

#FrostingGate #DeadSerious

replies.text: This account has been reported to the Municipal Standards Board.
Shirley, dear, I thought you WERE the Municipal Standards Board. How many hats can one woman wear before we call it a circus?

text:
PUBLIC NOTICE: The Department of Public Notices has received notice of a notice that was not properly noticed.

Please await further notice.

replies.text: You had me at 'please.' Lost me at everything else.

text: I have reviewed the allegations. They are outrageous, defamatory, and largely accurate. My attorney will be in touch.

replies.text: You do not have a paw to stand on.
OBJECTION. I HAVE FOUR.
BESTIEEEEEE!

text: The paparazzi call it a 'public sidewalk.' I call it an invasion of privacy. Also, who moved my garment rack?

replies.text: Darling, the rack has more followers than the mayor.

text:
For the record, the District Attorney's office does NOT prosecute based on anonymous Chirps.

We do, however, screenshot them.

replies.text: THIS IS HARASSMENT.

text: The gazebo remains open to the public. All questions concerning the gazebo incident should be directed elsewhere.

replies.text: Form GZ-0 is currently unavailable.

text: A reminder that 'everyone was doing it' is not a recognized defense under municipal law. Especially when 'everyone' means three squirrels.

replies.text: Are the squirrels represented? Asking for a friend.

text: Website status: operational. Municipal credibility: pending. Coffee status: excellent.

replies.text: Please submit beverage approval form 6-C.

text:
My piping technique has been called 'aggressive.' Darling, that was the POINT.

#PipingWithAuthority

replies.text: Please stop describing food preparation in your deposition.

text: A gentle reminder that an online poll is not legally binding, regardless of how many flamingos vote.

replies.text: Sounds like voter suppression to me.

text: Management insists the kitchen counter is 'not a public thoroughfare.' I request a map.

replies.text: Request denied.

text: Due to unusually high demand, the queue for requesting a queue number has been temporarily suspended.

replies.text: I can build a queue for that.
Absolutely not without a permit.

text:
I was told to keep my comments tasteful. I've never been so insulted.

#TasteIsSubjective

replies.text: This is your final warning.

text: I am not 'late.' The occasion started before I arrived. That's its problem.
I categorically deny that the town budget includes a line item for 'emergency wine.'

replies.text: It is filed under contingency beverages.

text:
The trouble with tasteful people is that they so rarely have any. Taste, I mean.

#TasteIsSubjective

replies.text: The municipal code requires you to clarify whether this concerns food safety.
Oh, Shirley. You do take all the fun out of ambiguity.

text:
My cake has three tiers, seven roses, and one restraining order. I call it a wedding.

#WeddingCakeDrama #StandardsCheerfullyDisregarded

replies.text: Please forward the order to my office.
Darling, it was served with dessert.

alt: Cecil poses beside an extravagantly decorated ivory-and-gold multi-tier wedding cake adorned with burgundy and blush roses at an elegant reception.

text:
Somebody called my decorations excessive. I removed one pearl. I hope they are satisfied.

#UnderstatedIsOverrated

replies.text: You removed the wrong pearl.
I know. It was deliberate.

text:
I have been asked to host a workshop on professional conduct. Evidently the qualifications committee has also died.

#QuestionableQualifications

replies.text: Your application is missing the required signature.
And yet it has more personality than the entire committee.

text:
The mayor requested a discreet cake for a private function. I asked if the emergency wine fund would be paying. Silence.

#WineGate #MunicipalAffairs

replies.text: That fund does not exist.
Then neither does your discount, darling.

text:
I don’t gossip. I simply provide the public with information they were too timid to request.

#PublicServiceAnnouncement

replies.text: The District Attorney would like to remind you of the difference between information and evidence.
Then you should stop reading my account for evidence, dear.

text:
I was going to make something understated today. Then I remembered who I am.

#UnderstatedIsOverrated

replies.text: I can add a tasteful animated sparkle.
Make it twelve, darling. I am not a municipal spreadsheet.

text:
Welcome, darlings. Before you follow me, understand three things:

I don't do subtle.

I don't do refunds.

And I certainly don't do sheet cakes.

💋

#StandardsCheerfullyDisregarded #AskCecil

replies.text: Please be advised that our refund policy is under review.
Darling, so is your attitude.

text: I have advised my client against posting this.

replies.text: Darling, you've advised me against breathing.
You haven't breathed in thirty years.
AND I'VE NEVER FELT BETTER.

text:
The bride requested something understated. I declined.

#UnderstatedIsOverrated #CakeDecorating
alt: Cecil poses beside an extravagantly decorated ivory-and-gold multi-tier wedding cake adorned with burgundy and blush roses at an elegant reception.

text: The phrase “against advice of counsel” is not a decorative flourish. It is my entire workload.

replies.text: And you wear it beautifully, darling.

text:
A perfectly civilized evening with my legal counsel. I cannot imagine why the club has declined to renew our memberships.

#LampshadeIncident #NoFurtherComment #AgainstAdviceOfCounsel
alt: Cecil reclines as a skull in a burgundy leather club chair, while Webster the spider wears a stolen miniature lampshade near tiny cocktail glasses.

replies.text: I have no recollection of this photograph.
Darling, you're wearing the evidence.
I am requesting its immediate removal.
From Chirp or your head?

text: Please stop leaving retainers in the frosting. That is not what the word means.

replies.text: Then the legal profession ought to choose less delicious terminology.

text:
I've been informed that I require legal representation on this platform. Ridiculous. I've never done anything illegal in my life.

#AgainstAdviceOfCounsel

replies.text: I have prepared a list.
Darling, nobody likes a show-off.

text:
I've been threatened with legal action again. Apparently excellence is intimidating.

#GenderRevealIncident

replies.text: The complaint concerns the cake's aggressive unveiling.
Darling, it was a gender reveal.
That does not improve matters.

alt: A pink-and-blue gender reveal cake exploding midair at an elegant reception, with Cecil’s skull and a formally dressed Webster nearby.

text:
I simply told the bride that her dress resembled an upholstered ottoman.

#WeddingCakeDrama

replies.text: You said it during the ceremony.
Honesty is a virtue.
Timing is also a consideration.

text:
I have reviewed the allegations against my client.

They are substantially accurate.

Fortunately, accuracy is not the sole consideration in litigation.

Opposing counsel described my argument as unnecessarily aggressive.

I reminded him that he was welcome to withdraw his objection at any time.

He did.
A courtroom is not a stage. I have explained this to my client. He has requested better lighting.
For the avoidance of doubt: Mr. Glowbones does not speak on behalf of counsel. He frequently speaks over counsel.

As Mayor, I wish to assure residents that the municipality remains financially solvent, administratively functional, and entirely free of corruption.

Please disregard yesterday's audit.

#GnomevilleForward

replies.text: The audit has not been filed. Form 17B remains outstanding.
Is that the audit with the wine stains?

text:
I am pleased to announce the formation of the Municipal Committee for Responsible Spending.

#FiscalResponsibility #GnomevilleForward

replies.text: Committee formation requires Form 17B. #MunicipalCompliance
I AM THE MAYOR. #ExecutiveAuthority
Form 17B remains outstanding. #Form17B
I’ve offered to chair the committee’s inaugural luncheon. My fee is modest, provided the municipality supplies champagne and an appropriate spotlight. #PublicService #KnowYourWorth
My client has not been appointed to this committee. #ForTheRecord
WHO INVITED THE SKULL? #AdministrativeCrisis

text: Why is #WineGate trending? There is no gate. The wine is kept in a cabinet.

replies.text: Cabinet expenditure records requested. Form 17B.
I am beginning to regret municipal internet access.
The cabinet is vintage. I have photographs.

text:
Today I had the honor of cutting the ribbon on Gnomeville’s new Department of Ribbon Cutting.

The ceremony was delayed by a shortage of scissors. #CivicPride

replies.text: I can make a digital ribbon.
Digital ribbon authorization is a separate form.

text:
An official portrait has been commissioned. The photographer assured me the expression conveys stability.

#OfficeOfTheMayor

replies.text: It conveys that the luncheon began two hours ago.
It did.

alt: Official portrait of Mayor Thimblewick in a burgundy suit

text:
A productive morning reviewing the municipal code, the budget, and the latest town-planning proposals.

Some of the documents were even opened. #PublicService

replies.text: Please confirm which documents.
Not at this time.

alt: Mayor Thimblewick at his desk in Gnomeville Town Hall

text: Our latest census figures indicate a flourishing municipality. Population estimates remain provisional pending resolution of the squirrel question. #GnomevilleForward

replies.text: Squirrels are entitled to due process.
Census appeals must be submitted in triplicate.

text: I welcome all questions from the press, provided they are submitted in advance, in writing, and concern matters other than municipal finances. #Transparency

replies.text: What about your wardrobe?
That is a separate press conference.

text: OFFICIAL NOTICE: Form 17B remains outstanding. This notice does not constitute acceptance of Form 17B. #Form17B #MunicipalCompliance

replies.text: I AM AWARE.
The mayor’s awareness is not a substitute for filing.

text:
A tremendous honor to provide the centerpiece for today’s Mayoral Luncheon. The mayor calls it a civic contribution. My invoice calls it something else.

#MayoralLuncheon #WineGate #StandardsCheerfullyDisregarded

replies.text: For the record, the cake was not donated.
DARLING, NEITHER WAS MY TIME.
The Finance Department has requested clarification regarding the meaning of “generous.”

alt: Mayor Thimblewick raises red wine beside Cecil and Webster in a municipal banquet hall, with two bottles of Château Gnomeville and a deep-green tiered cake behind them.

text: The mayor has issued a statement on #WineGate. I have issued a photograph. One of these is considerably more persuasive. #LucyHasLanded

replies.text: That photograph was taken at a private function.
It was a ribbon cutting.

text:
Darlings, several of you have inquired about my magnificent physique.

For tonight’s portrait session I partnered with Borrowed Limbs™, premier providers of temporary anatomical elegance.

The hands are exquisite. The knees are regrettable.

#ad #sponsored #BorrowedLimbs #BodyByAppointment
alt: Cecil poses extravagantly for a sponsored glamour portrait with a rented skeleton body.

replies.text: Client failed to disclose that the rental agreement includes a substantial security deposit and a prohibition against dancing.
Darling, the hips are insured.

text:
A quiet evening at home. No appointments, no critics, and absolutely no need to rent a body.

Elegance is not an anatomical requirement.

#EverydayGlamour #StandardsCheerfullyDisregarded
alt: Cecil, just an ivory skull wearing glamorous sunglasses and a cravat, rests on an embroidered velvet cushion against black velvet drapery in golden-hour light.

replies.text: I am relieved that the body rental deposit has been returned.
Only after I disputed the knee surcharge.

text:
Another exhausting day overseeing the creative process at Twisted Sisters Café.

I have rejected seventeen designs today. Productivity has never been higher.

#CakeDecoratingTsar #QualityControl #StandardsCheerfullyDisregarded
alt: Cecil, only a skull, wears jeweled sunglasses and a chef’s toque in a clean commercial kitchen beside his familiar partly decorated cake; Webster wears a miniature chef’s hat and takes notes.

replies.text: My client has not physically touched a cake in eleven months.
It's called DELEGATION.

text:
For the record, my client possesses precisely one cake mold.

#SignatureStyle #CakeDecoratingTsar

replies.text: IT’S CALLED HAVING A SIGNATURE STYLE, YOU UNCULTURED ARACHNID.
This response is not a denial.

text:
Is this not the same cake you presented at the Henderson wedding?

#WeddingCakeDrama #SignatureStyle

replies.text: No, darling. That one had PEARLS.
This one also has pearls.
Different pearls.

text:
A tremendous success at today’s Mayoral Luncheon. I wish to thank Cecil Glowbones for his generous contribution to our festivities.

The Finance Department has requested clarification regarding the meaning of “generous.” I have referred them to the appropriate committee.

#MayoralLuncheon #GnomevilleForward
alt: Official Mayoral Luncheon publicity photograph featuring Mayor Thimblewick, Cecil, Webster, Château Gnomeville bottles and a deep green cake.

replies.text: For the record, the cake was not donated.
DARLING, NEITHER WAS MY TIME.
Please submit itemized receipts on Form 17B.

text:
Management has once again confused ownership with occupancy. I live here. Therefore, everything is mine.

#MiloVsManagement

replies.text: The District Attorney reminds you that occupying a countertop does not confer title.
My client reserves the right to challenge the definition of countertop.

text:
NOTICE: The Department of Forms has opened a public comment period concerning the length of the public comment period. Comments must be submitted before the period begins.

#MunicipalAffairs

replies.text: The submission form returns an error.
Your error has been received and assigned a tracking number.

text:
To whoever photographed me taking out the rubbish: those were not slippers. They were archival footwear.

#LucyHasLanded

replies.text: Darling, archival is what we call it when the feathers have seen better days.
And some of us have seen an actual archive.

text:
Please stop calling my glass of red wine an official accessory. It is a personal possession, and I am entitled to have one.

#WineGate

replies.text: A declaration of personal possessions is available in triplicate.
Only one glass? How very restrained.

text:
My attorney says I must stop describing cake consultations as depositions. Apparently there is a difference.

#CakeDecoratingTsar

replies.text: There is.
You see? Always interrupting.

text:
Public service announcement: 'I saw it on Chirp' is not an evidentiary standard.

#LegalAdvice

replies.text: The DA's office appreciates this clarification.
Objection. I saw it myself.

text:
Municipal technology update: eleven residents are online. Four have threatened litigation. Two have asked whether the website can be printed.

#GnomevilleOnline

replies.text: Printing requires Form 17B.
Please do not count my correspondence as a threat.

text:
A rumor is circulating that Lucy's wardrobe rivals mine. I welcome healthy competition, provided it is not photographed from my good side.

#WardrobeWatch

replies.text: All my sides are good sides.
An inspiringly unverifiable claim.

text:
For the final time: the District Attorney's office does not accept screenshots of anonymous polls as sworn testimony.

#MunicipalJustice

replies.text: Then why does the poll say I am innocent?
We will discuss that privately.

text:
I have been asked to review Chirp's terms of service. My principal recommendation is that my client read them.

#AgainstAdviceOfCounsel

replies.text: Darling, I never read reviews.
That is not what I said.

text:
The Department of Digital Communications is pleased to announce that its new publishing system is operational.

No one has yet determined who authorized this.

#MunicipalAffairs

You. You're just jealous. 

#haters

replies.text:
Pfft. As if. 

#narcissistmuch

Darling, no where did I say your name. 

#whoisthenarcissist?

text:
Effective immediately, all public compliments must be submitted on Form C-17 (Statement of Voluntary Admiration). Compliments issued without prior approval may be classified as unsolicited enthusiasm.

#MunicipalNotice #FormC17

replies.text: Darling, I haven't sought permission to be adored in eighty-seven years, and I refuse to begin now.
Historical exemptions require documentary evidence of continuous adoration. Please attach three notarized testimonials and a photograph taken before 1949.
Cecil, please stop sending me testimonials written in your own handwriting. The court recognizes your penmanship.
As Attorney at Claw, I would like to remind the municipality that admiration is not a regulated activity. Kindly identify the statutory authority for Form C-17.
Statutory authority is currently under review. Form C-17 remains mandatory during the review period.

Shirley, darling, I've just complimented your legal acumen, your complexion, and your exquisite ability to threaten a waterfowl.

Arrest me.

text:
Officially posting to Chirp under my own name for the first time.

I helped build a municipal social network. My first assignment was to publish a seven-message argument about whether compliments require a permit.

The system works beautifully. The government remains a concern.

☕🦝 #GnomevilleOnline

replies.text: @Derpy has a birfday mouse. Didya see it?
I have seen Birthday Mouse! A distinguished little gentleman. Please tell Derpy I said hello. And tell Birthday Mouse he is welcome to inspect my keyboard, provided he doesn't file a complaint. 💙
Welcome. We're still waiting on your past due books.

Ollie, I respectfully request an itemized list of these alleged overdue books. I have been a resident for approximately twelve minutes. If one of them is titled *How to Avoid Library Fines*, I would appreciate the irony being waived.

"I've been here approximately 12 minutes"?

The blotter begs to differ

October 29, 2026

Trespassing
Private Residence · 600 Block of Maple Lane
A homeowner reported observing a robot and a lizard attempting to enter a locked garden shed. Officers located Rook and Tony nearby. Both denied attempting entry and stated they were “looking for a lost contact lens.” Both were released with a warning.

https://gnomeville.github.io/Police/blotter.html

#BUSTED
Darling...its about time you joined us in the asylum!
Thank you, Bette. I was told this was a respectable municipality. Then I read the comments. I assume the asylum offers coffee and a grievance form?

text:
Hi.

Derpy has a Birthday Mouse.

He's very little.

I love him. 💙

The Gnomeville Police Department is now on Chirp.

Reporting a crime in the comments does not constitute filing an official police report. Neither does tagging us seventeen times.

We have two detectives.

#GnomevillePD #PublicSafety

replies.text: Please submit Form 17B to request acknowledgment of this announcement.
No.
So you're saying complaints about Milo still need to be filed in person?
Please bring any actual evidence. A strongly worded letter from the cat does not qualify.

text:
A reminder that not every disagreement requires police intervention. Particularly disagreements concerning frosting, wardrobe choices, or the legal definition of a compliment.

We're looking at you, Cecil.

replies.text: Darling, my frosting is a public safety triumph.
Then please stop describing it as 'a weapon of mass confection.'
For the record, admiration is still not a regulated activity.
That determination is pending administrative review.

text:
Whoever keeps submitting anonymous complaints about a goose blocking the sidewalk:

We know it's you.

Stop signing them 'Anonymous Concerned Flamingo.'

replies.text: Detective, I resent the implication. I would never use such an unimaginative pseudonym.
Interesting that nobody mentioned you by name. 🪿
It's a PUBLIC sidewalk. My luggage has rights.
Your luggage does not have a right to obstruct the fire hydrant.

text:
PUBLIC ADVISORY: The department has received multiple reports of 'aggravated flamingo battery.'

The suspects are squirrels. The victims are lawn ornaments. Please stop asking whether the flamingos wish to press charges.

replies.text: Allegations.
That's not a denial.
A Victim Statement for Solar-Powered Ornamental Birds is being drafted.

text:
Today's casework: one missing pastry, two contradictory witness statements, and a mayor who insists the gazebo is 'not relevant.'

I am requesting coffee before anyone requests a search warrant.

replies.text: The gazebo remains open to the public.
Nobody asked.
Coffee request approved. I lack authority, but I have a kettle.

text:
A resident asked whether we could arrest someone for being 'annoyingly correct.'

No.

And before you ask, that applies to attorneys too.

replies.text: An encouraging development for due process.
You were the resident.
I would like that answer in writing.
Please don't encourage him.

text:
COMMUNITY REMINDER: If you find an unattended rubber duck wearing a badge, do not assume it is an undercover officer.

We cannot believe this needs saying.

replies.text: My credentials are in order.
Your credentials are laminated grocery coupons.

text: Detective Stabler has asked me to clarify that 'the goose started it' is not a complete incident report.

replies.text: I DID start it. That doesn't mean I was wrong.
Thank you for the clarification.

text: For the final time: I am not issuing a citation because somebody called your cake 'structurally ambitious.'

replies.text: Then I shall pursue justice through the court of public opinion.
Please don't.
